systems.platform: eight microservices on Amazon Web Services; built by PANEOTECH with Effica SYS Co SARL
systems.owner: UNDP Mauritania, operated with the National Meteorological Office, the Directorate General for Civil Security and Crisis Management and the National Society for Rural Development
systems.tiers: national agencies and regional agricultural delegations; the local authorities of Kaédi and Rosso are named among those the system serves in the pilot zones

note: A supplier's account of a national early warning system run by national agencies; the local authorities of Kaédi and Rosso are named as partners and recipients of alerts, with nothing stated about a connection at their offices or work done in the system there.
